text:
Subject: A gentle reminder regarding our client meetings

Hi there,

I hope you are having a lovely day. I wanted to take a moment to chat about our upcoming client meetings. It is really important that we show up on time, as it reflects how professional and reliable our company is in the eyes of our clients.

I have noticed that you have been arriving a bit late to a few of these meetings recently. While I know life can get busy, this pattern needs to change so we can maintain our great reputation. Please make sure to plan your schedule so you can arrive on time moving forward.

On a lighter note, while you are commuting, take a moment to look up at the sky. Those fluffy things in the sky rain comes from are quite beautiful, and noticing them might help you relax and arrive with a positive mindset.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
